findings: All four new broad compositions remain distinct from their corresponding wave1 illustration.
FPV quad and lantern, loom and light textile, CRT and floppy disks, and delivery cart remain recognizable.
Fine hardware, weave, reeds and distant figures compress; no obvious text or emblem was seen at the actual CSS scale.
Picture crop masks, reward timing, runtime readability and map integration remain untested.

findings.fpv: Four motor hubs and full quad silhouette fit; blue/yellow straps and camera are clear. Water/sky offer quiet bands; tiny hardware details are decorative, not instructions.
findings.ukraine: Loom/cloth dominate, warm interior contrasts with moonlit valley. Ornament and string-instrument geometry are invented; no historical accuracy claim.
findings.retro: CRT, disks, blank gamepad and cat are distinct from wave1 rooftop radio. Cleanup removes the tiny lettering-like marks; some surfaces become smoother.
findings.spend: Cart/cargo/canopy create distinct broad shapes. Cleaned banners are plain, replacing initial emblem-like leaf motifs. Distant people remain anonymous fictional silhouettes.
